Composition & Indication

Montelukast 10mg — 30 Tablets (Generic for Singulair®) contains Montelukast Sodium 10 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 30 Tablets at the official 10mg strength. The standard indication is the management of asthma and seasonal allergic rhinitis, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Montelukast 10mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.
